audience: event organizers who sell tickets on Eventbrite

useCases.title: Check ticket sales and capacity of events
useCases.text: The AI reads the ticket types of an event with price and quantity sold, its capacity, and a sales report with gross, net and fees per time bucket.

useCases.title: See who registered and who checked in
useCases.text: The AI lists the attendees of one event or of all events with ticket type, status and check-in state, and reads one attendee.

useCases.title: Review orders and buyers
useCases.text: The AI lists orders of an event or organization with buyer name, email, status and costs, and reads one order with its tickets.

useCases.title: Check, create or change discount codes
useCases.text: The AI lists discounts and access codes with the number sold, creates a promo code, public discount or access code, and changes amount, uses or dates.

useCases.title: Create a draft event with tickets and publish it
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft event, adds a venue and ticket types with price and capacity, and then publishes it so tickets go on sale.

useCases.title: Copy or change an existing event
useCases.text: The AI duplicates an event with its tickets into a new event with a new name and dates, or changes fields of an event.
